heading: Meet the Team
intro: A small but dedicated team, we at Kelly Marie Wellbeing are passionate about delivering quality wellbeing support for businesses and workforces.

people.name: Kelly Marie
people.bio: A psychotherapist with years of clinical experience working with individuals, couples, young people and organisations. Kelly's practice is grounded in psychodynamic theory alongside integrative and trauma-informed approaches. She specialises in workplace therapy and wellbeing, and has worked with organisations including LADBible and Genuit Group to provide in-house counselling for staff, and deliver mental health awareness training and coaching.

people.name: Ella Kitching
people.bio: Ella delivers mental health awareness training, hosts The Kelly Marie Podcast and runs our social media. She is a psychology graduate with a passion for wellbeing and hands-on experience working as a key adult and coach for young people struggling with their mental health. Ella is trained at Level 1 & 2 in counselling concepts, and is currently undergoing mindfulness training.

people.name: Will Ellis
people.bio: Will delivers mental health awareness training with his positive outlook and passion for empowering others to improve their wellbeing. He is also undergoing a course in mindfulness to broaden his knowledge.
